_comment: Bus-repo hook registration for ctam-architecture. NOT a copy of
- block-git-writes.sh IS registered. R13/W7 bind conduct in every repo, and this
one authors the rule. The file is a byte-identical copy of the bus source at
submodule itself, so it is copied rather than reached through _arch/.
When the bus source changes, re-copy it; the two must not drift.
- require-red-test.sh is NOT registered. It enforces R2/T1, which govern edits to
src/main/**. This repository has no src/ and ships no code — Markdown and shell
only — so the hook would have nothing to guard and would obstruct every doc edit.
